description: A gray T-shirt lies on a yellow tabletop in front of you, with a brown fabric backdrop behind it. The right hand lifts and shakes out the shirt, then both hands spread it flat and smooth it; the left hand folds the left side inward toward the center and the right hand folds the right side over it to form a long rectangle, then both hands fold the bottom up to make a compact bundle and pat it flat as a two-hand object before releasing.
